## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Scope

- [ ] The change stays within the knowledge-layer scope in `PROJECT.md`.
- [ ] Documentation, configuration or tests are updated as needed.
- [ ] No unrelated refactor is mixed in.

## Checks

- [ ] `make check`

## Data and security

- [ ] No data payloads, run artifacts, `.env`, databases or credentials are included.
- [ ] No restricted or unlicensed material is included.
- [ ] No personal or vessel-identifying information is included.
- [ ] No internal project names, task identifiers or absolute local paths are included.

## Notes

Add reviewer context, follow-ups or known limitations.
